scientific_role.purpose: build and falsify an outcome-blind endpoint-cost selector before a separate effect protocol
scientific_role.paper_role_if_later_confirmed: Decision Corpus label-acquisition extension with endpoint rather than materialized-pair cost accounting

prior_work_boundary.distinction_under_test: one paid endpoint execution reveals one scalar outcome; all materialized sibling preferences among executed endpoints are deterministically derived and statistically dependent

cost_and_dependence_accounting.primary_pair_weight_for_future_fit: 2/k per unordered pair; half of that per antisymmetric orientation
cost_and_dependence_accounting.weight_invariant: sum of unordered pair weights in a complete selected clique equals k-1

feature_map.input: endpoint code only; Unicode character n-grams are encoded to UTF-8 only for deterministic hashing
feature_map.signed_hash: two seeded zlib.crc32 calls; one bucket and one sign

selection.unopened_parent_action: select two siblings maximizing rank-one logdet gain per endpoint
selection.objective: log(1+q^T A_inverse q) per newly executed endpoint
selection.tie_break: ascending SHA-256 of action kind parent and sorted endpoints
